formulations.Polymer system Notes: High molecular weight PEO (900 K, Aldrich; average type not specified) dried under partial vacuum (<5 mmHg argon) at 45-50 °C for ~48 h. Lithium salts recrystallized in acetonitrile and vacuum dried ~48 h (LiCF3SO3 and LiClO4 at 100-110 °C, LiAsF6 at 140-150 °C).
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Conductivity was measured on heating (25-130 °C) without preheating. The log σ vs 1/T curves show a knee at the eutectic melting or end-of-dissolution temperature, and each region fits the Arrhenius law σ = A exp(-Ea/RT). The paper gives Ea only for T > 60 °C (60-130 °C for CF3SO3, 60-120 °C for ClO4 and AsF6). It gives no numerical low-T Ea and no prefactors. It states that Ea is essentially independent of the anion, at ~0.7 eV.
formulations.Notes: Films cast from acetonitrile solution (12-20% by vol), solvent evaporated at 25 °C, ~50 μm thick films, then dried under partial vacuum at 95-100 °C for a minimum of 48 h. Stored in glove box at 25 °C until crystallization complete; water content <25 ppm (Karl-Fischer). Conductivity cells not preheated; measured on first heating from 25 °C.
formulations.Reference: C. D. Robitaille and D. Fauteux, Phase Diagrams and Conductivity Characterization of Some PEO-LiX Electrolytes, J. Electrochem. Soc. 133 (2), 315 (1986)
